cohort: 138 children (mean age 8.0 years ± 1.7) treated for severe MIH at a dental office in Berlin between 2008 and 2019, and 44 control children with the same date of birth (mean age 7.7 years ± 1.7)
finding: No significant association was found between MIH and the pH value of the umbilical cord blood or birth by cesarean section in the examined patient population.
mod_finding: No significant differences in pH value were found between MIH and control groups for female children born with or without cesarean section, or for male children born by cesarean section.
